_meta.purpose: Synthetic week for the Weekly International v4 board (TECH_DESIGN §h.2): units and rigs. Invented names, plates, drivers and references only — the repo is public.
notes: Field names are the facade labels of the live Worker map. Derived fields the Worker never returns («Loading/Delivery Summary», «Client Name») are deliberately absent: points come from ORDER STOPS, client names from CLIENTS, as in production.
«Plan Week Start» (I019) is read only where the Worker maps it; it carries the «μεταφέρθηκε» case.
Week Number appears only on the two W+1 exports (E026/E027) because the cross-week read filters on it; the main reads are date ranges, trimmed client-side.
All times are written as UTC ISO and land on the stated Athens day (UTC+3 until 25/10/2026).
